paper_title: 1.4 Million Open-Source Distilled Reasoning Dataset to Empower Large   Language Model Training
caption: Difficulty distribution of the data entries. Most of the dataset entries are classified as Medium (51.8%) or Hard (25.7%). A smaller proportion falls into the Easy (11.2%), Very Hard (6.5%), and Very Easy (4.7%) categories.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of difficulty levels within a dataset of reasoning entries. The chart contains five slices, representing the categories “Very easy”, “Easy”, “Medium”, “Hard”, and “Very hard”. The slices are colored red, light green, pink, blue, and light blue, respectively. The “Very easy” slice represents approximately 4.7% of the data, “Easy” is approximately 11.2%, “Medium” comprises 51.8%, “Hard” accounts for 25.7%, and “Very hard” represents about 6.5%. Percentage values are displayed inside each slice. A legend is included, listing each difficulty level and corresponding color. The slices appear to be arranged in descending order based on their proportional size, starting with “Medium” and proceeding clockwise to “Very easy”.
